description: Tahap 2 (T2.7–T2.16) + Tahap 3 (T3.4–T3.13) — Complete game flow APIs (Selesai Main, payment, Buka Kembali, lock/unlock), all game UI screens, financial APIs (manual kas transactions, stok bola, pembelian, koreksi stok), and all financial UI screens. Requires FEAT-003 (billing engine, auto-transaction service, iuran). This is the largest feature — all the interconnected game+finance logic.
steps: 1. Create `src/app/api/v1/pertemuan/[id]/peserta/[pesertaId]/selesai-main/route.ts` (POST): load all sesi for this pertemuan containing this pemain, call `hitungTagihan()` from calculator.ts, set peserta_pertemuan.status_main='selesai', store tagihan integer. Return breakdown: bola cost, lapangan cost, pembulatan, tagihan total. (T2.7)

2. Create `src/app/api/v1/pertemuan/[id]/peserta/[pesertaId]/bayar/route.ts` (POST): validate body `{ jumlah: int, metode: string }`. Rules: (a) tagihan > 0: jumlah must be >= tagihan, excess recorded; (b) tagihan = 0 (bebas_biaya): all jumlah recorded as kelebihan; (c) call auto-transaction service to create kas records (dapat_diubah=false). Set status_main='lunas', dibayar=jumlah, metode_bayar. Return updated peserta. (T2.8)

3. Create `src/app/api/v1/pertemuan/[id]/peserta/[pesertaId]/buka-kembali/route.ts` (POST): validate body `{ alasan: string }` (required). Call `reverseTransactions()` for this peserta's payment. Reset status_main='bermain', tagihan=0, dibayar=0, metode_bayar=null, selesai_pada=null. Log activity with alasan. (T2.9)

4. Create `src/app/api/v1/pertemuan/[id]/kunci/route.ts` (POST) and `src/app/api/v1/pertemuan/[id]/buka-kunci/route.ts` (POST): Kunci: check all peserta have status_main='lunas', set terkunci=true. Buka kunci: require `{ alasan: string }`, set terkunci=false, log activity. All other mutation endpoints must check terkunci and return 400 if locked. (T2.10)

5. Create `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/page.tsx` (replaces placeholder): list of pertemuan sorted by tanggal DESC, each card shows tanggal, player count, lock status. FAB to create new pertemuan (calls POST /api/v1/pertemuan with default date). (T2.11)

6. Create `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/[id]/page.tsx`: detail page with 3 tabs — Sesi, Tagihan, Pengeluaran. Tab routing using URL hash or search param. Shows pertemuan tanggal, lock status, Kunci/Buka Kunci button. (T2.12)

7. Create `src/components/pertemuan/TambahSesiSheet.tsx`: bottom sheet with: (a) chip grid of last-played pemain for quick select, (b) text input with autocomplete for adding new/existing pemain by name (calls quick-add API), (c) stepper for bola_terpakai (default 1, min 1), (d) lapangan radio (1 or 2), (e) toggle 'Ditanggung seseorang' + pemain selector if enabled, (f) Simpan button, (g) Duplikat Sesi Sebelumnya button. (T2.13)

8. Create `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/[id]/tabs/SesiTab.tsx`: list of all sesi with player chips. Each sesi card has edit and delete buttons. FAB opens TambahSesiSheet. Duplikat button on last sesi. (T2.13)

9. Create `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/[id]/tabs/TagihanTab.tsx`: list of all peserta_pertemuan. Status badges: Bermain (grey), Selesai (yellow), Lunas (green). For Bermain: button 'Selesai Main' → shows detail sheet with breakdown, confirm button. For Selesai: 'Lunas 1 Ketukan' button (uses exact tagihan amount) + expand to change amount/method + 'Buka Kembali' with alasan input. (T2.14)
10. Implement lock/unlock button in `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/[id]/page.tsx`: Kunci button disabled unless all peserta are 'lunas'. Buka Kunci button shows alasan modal. (T2.15)

11. Create `src/app/api/v1/kas/route.ts` (GET, POST): GET returns paginated transaksi_kas with filters: tanggal range (or bulan), tipe (pemasukan/pengeluaran), kategori_id. POST creates manual transaction (nominal > 0, kategori_id valid for grup, keterangan optional). Transactions created this way have dapat_diubah=true. (T3.5)

12. Create `src/app/api/v1/kas/[id]/route.ts` (GET, PUT, DELETE): GET single transaction. PUT only if dapat_diubah=true and pertemuan not locked. DELETE only if dapat_diubah=true and pertemuan not locked. Log activity on change/delete. (T3.13)

13. Create `src/app/(protected)/kas/page.tsx` (replaces placeholder): list of transaksi_kas with filter bar (tanggal/bulan toggle, tipe filter, kategori filter). Each row shows tipe colored badge, nominal, keterangan, kategori. FAB for add income/expense (two buttons). Paginated. (T3.6)

14. Create `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/[id]/tabs/PengeluaranTab.tsx`: list of transaksi_kas linked to this pertemuan. Add Sewa Lapangan button (prefills nominal from konfigurasi biaya_sewa_default, with lapangan number select). Locked pertemuan shows read-only. (T3.7)
15. Create `src/app/api/v1/iuran/route.ts` additions — also create GET per-pemain history endpoint at `src/app/api/v1/pemain/[id]/iuran/route.ts`. (T3.3/T3.4)

16. Create `src/app/(protected)/pemain/[id]/page.tsx`: pemain detail page with: edit button, iuran history section with current month status badge (Member/Non-Member), 'Catat Iuran' button that opens iuran form (bulan selector, nominal field with minimum validation). (T3.4)

17. Create `src/app/api/v1/stok/route.ts` (GET): compute current stok = stok_awal (from konfigurasi) + SUM(pembelian_bola.jumlah_tabung × isi_per_tabung) + SUM(koreksi_stok.jumlah) − SUM(sesi.bola_terpakai) for this grup. Return current stok, and riwayat (paginated list of purchases and corrections sorted by date). (T3.8)

18. Create `src/app/api/v1/stok/beli/route.ts` (POST): body `{ jumlah_tabung, harga_total }`. Compute total bola = jumlah_tabung × konfigurasi.isi_per_tabung. Insert pembelian_bola. Create transaksi_kas (pengeluaran, kategori 'Pembelian Bola', dapat_diubah=false). Return updated stok. (T3.9)

19. Create `src/app/api/v1/stok/koreksi/route.ts` (POST): body `{ jumlah: int (positive or negative), alasan: string }`. Require non-empty alasan (return 422 if missing). Insert koreksi_stok. Log activity. Return updated stok. (T3.10)

20. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/stok/page.tsx`: card showing current stok count, riwayat list (paginated), two buttons: Beli Bola (opens sheet with jumlah_tabung stepper + harga_total input) and Koreksi Stok (opens sheet with jumlah input + alasan textarea). (T3.11)
acceptance_criteria: POST selesai-main returns correct billing breakdown matching calculator.ts output
POST bayar with jumlah less than tagihan returns 400 with clear error message
POST bayar creates corresponding transaksi_kas record with dapat_diubah=false
POST buka-kembali requires alasan and reverses kas transactions
POST kunci returns 400 if any peserta is not 'lunas'
POST stok/beli creates both pembelian_bola record and pengeluaran transaksi_kas
All pertemuan UI tabs (Sesi, Tagihan, Pengeluaran) render at 360px without horizontal scroll
TambahSesiSheet completes in maximum 2 taps for duplicate session
Selesai Main to Lunas flow completable one-handed on mobile
`pnpm build` completes with zero errors after this FEAT
